jobs.description:
JOB REQUISITION

Cloud Infrastructure Senior Manager

LOCATION

NEW YORK CITY

ADDITIONAL LOCATION(S)

WASHINGTON DC - MCLEAN

Job Description

Technology Consulting
Cloud Infrastructure
Senior Manager

You Belong Here

The Protiviti Career provides opportunity to learn, inspire, and advance within a collaborative and inclusive culture.  We hire curious individuals for whom learning is a passion. We lean into our mission: We Care. We Collaborate. We Deliver.

At every level, we champion leaders who live our values of integrity, inclusion, innovation, and commitment to success
. Imagining our work as a journey, we believe integrity guides our way, inclusion moves us forward together, innovation creates new destinations, and our commitment to success empowers us to deliver on our vision to be the most trusted global consulting firm.

Where We Need You

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Consulting Senior Manager to join our growing Infrastructure, Cloud, & Security Engineering team.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Manager, you’ll partner with our clients to identify and manage risk. You'll develop strategies to solve complex business problems using new ways of thinking, and devise solutions to support your clients' needs through using the latest tools and methods.  You’ll develop lasting relationships with client personnel and further these relationships through quality product delivery.  You’ll foster a network within the business community and serve as an ambassador of Protiviti in the market. You will also be a mentor and provide performance development to teams as you oversee the successful completion of project work plans.

What Will Help You Be Successful

You enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, and cloud platforms to design, build, migrate, and/or secure systems and environments.
You are passionate about building trusted relationships with C-level executives and providing exceptional experiences that translate to additional project work.
You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.
You promote a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members. 
You create development opportunities for others, including participating in the creation and rollout of training, and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.
You enjoy discovering prospective project work with current and potential clients through networking, knowledge-building, and client interactions.
You excel at identifying opportunities to integrate product solutions and resources to improve client service capabilities.
You view client challenges as opportunities to add value and can translate that into new project proposals and sales.
You are seen as a valued contributor to thought leadership and encourage knowledge-sharing and collaboration across teams.
You have interest in managing a diverse portfolio of clients across industries.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Recent hands-on design, deployment, and/or administration experience in Windows Server and Linux systems administration
Working familiarity with Unix variants and Mac OS; prior administration experience a plus
Working familiarity with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure and other IaaS providers preferred
Strong enterprise networking design, deployment, and/or administration experience
Working familiarity with enterprise-class vendors and product lines strongly preferred (e.g. Cisco, Cisco Meraki, HPE/Aruba, Juniper, Extreme, Brocade)
Working familiarity with enterprise-class network security appliance vendors and product lines strongly preferred (e.g. Cisco, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Fortinet)
Working familiarity with SMB/”prosumer” vendors and product lines a plus (e.g. Ubiquiti/UBNT, SonicWall, Mikrotik) a plus
Working familiarity with load balancers, VPN appliances/concentrators a plus
In depth understanding of current enterprise design patterns and norms for basic networking capabilities/concepts (e.g. TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN segmentation, routing and switching, wireless)
Strong familiarity with SMB and entry-level on premises computing infrastructure technologies
Working familiarity with multiple server hardware vendors and associated management tools/platforms (e.g. Dell, HPE, Cisco, SuperMicro) strongly preferred
Working familiarity with hypervisor platforms (e.g. VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, or others) strongly preferred
Strong familiarity with enterprise storage
Working familiarity with DAS, SAN, and NAS/filer solutions
Working understanding of contemporary network storage protocols and interconnect methods (e.g. iSCSI, CIFS, FibreChannel, NFS)
Strong familiarity with basic on premises infrastructure management best practices
Rack management
Power and cooling demand management
Physical security
Strong familiarity with scripting for administrative, auditing, and other operational purposes
Prior experience writing PowerShell, Python, BASH/other Linux shell scripts strongly preferred 
Prior experience with typical infrastructure and server/endpoint management toolsets
Performance and capacity management tools
Endpoint management / RMM platforms
Patch and vulnerability management tools
Log and event aggregation technologies (Kafka, SIEMs, Splunk, etc.)
Prior experience with capacity planning, VM/server “right-sizing”, performance analysis
Prior experience and ownership designing server, network, application solutions through deployment phase
Prior experience administrating Office 365 services
Prior experience administrating Microsoft Exchange, Google G Suite/Workspace is a plus
Experience designing, building, or remediating an environment to meet specific regulatory requirements such as PCI-DSS, CMMC, NIST 800-53.
Prior experience translating undocumented systems / applications / operating procedures into usable documentation is absolutely necessary; Ability to update or create visualizations of dependency maps or architecture overviews is a must
Prior experience with integration of IT systems in a post-merger/acquisition environment
Prior experience with application rationalization / dependency mapping exercises
Prior experience designing, implementing, or administrating backup and replication/continuity solutions for server, storage, and application infrastructure
Familiarity with typical project management methods (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
Prior experience translating business requirements (e.g. compliance controls, vendor / business partner requirements) into technical configurations / solutions
Prior experience dealing with third party hardware/software/service vendors preferred
Prior experience translating business continuity / disaster recovery requirements into technical solution designs preferred
Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network, including with senior executives. 
Successfully pursuing business development opportunities and identifying and implementing strategies to obtain new work or clientele.
Ability to translate and communicate issues, risks or challenges to client personnel, including executives. 
Leadership and direct supervisory experience of teams including conducting performance appraisals, mentoring and coaching, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.  

Your Educational And Professional Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in (Comp Sci, Comp Eng, Networking) or relevant field, or equivalent experience delivering technology or consulting solutions.
7+ years working in professional services or related fields.
Professional Certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert or similar strongly preferred.
Excellent verbal and written English 
Comfortable collaborating with key business executives, system/application owners or stakeholders in group conversation or direct interview contexts
Ability to rapidly shift between planning / design work and practical execution (“hands on keyboard” tasks for discovery or implementation) is an absolute necessity
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills required
Personal projects / demonstrated extracurricular interest in technology a plus

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

Starting salary is based on a full-time equivalent schedule. Placement in the range is dependent upon experience, skills and geographic work location. Below is the salary range for this job.

$146,000.00 - $234,000.00

Our annual bonus plan provides eligible employees additional cash and/or discretionary stock compensation opportunities. Below is the bonus target opportunity for this job.

14%

The total cash range is estimated from the sum of the base salary range plus the bonus target opportunity. Below is the estimated total cash range for this job.

$166,440.00 - $266,760.00

Employees are eligible for medical, dental, and vision coverages, FSA and HSA healthcare accounts, life and accident insurance, adoption and fertility assistance, paid parental leave up to 10 weeks, and short/long term disability. We offer eligible employees a company 401(k) savings and investment plan with an employer match of 50% on the first 6% of your contributions. We provide Choice Time Off (CTO) for vacation, personal needs, and sick time. The amount of (CTO) varies based on years of service. New hires receive up to 20 days of CTO per calendar year. Protiviti also recognizes up to 11 paid holidays each calendar year.

Learn more about the variety of rewards we offer at Protiviti at https://www.protiviti.com/sites/default/files/2026-01/2026_u.s._benefit_highlights.pdf.

Any benefits outlined are part of our reward offerings for full-time employees in the U.S. Your Open Enrollment materials, insurance contracts, plan documents and Summary Plan Descriptions together comprise the official plan document which legally governs the administration of your benefit plans. Protiviti reserves the right to terminate or amend your benefit plans in any way and at any time.

Protiviti is committed to being an equal employment employer offering opportunities to all job seekers, including individuals with disabilities. If you believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or to apply for a position, please contact us by sending an email to HRSolutions@roberthalf.com or call 1.855.744.6947 for assistance.

jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Focused on employment and labor law since 1958, Jackson Lewis P.C.’s 1,000+ attorneys located in major cities nationwide consistently identify and respond to new ways workplace law intersects business. We help employers develop proactive strategies, strong policies and business-oriented solutions to cultivate high-functioning workforces that are engaged and stable, and share our clients’ goals to emphasize belonging and respect for the contributions of every employee.

The Firm is ranked in the First Tier nationally in the category of Labor and Employment Litigation, as well as in both Employment Law and Labor Law on behalf of Management, in the U.S. News - Best Lawyers® “Best Law Firms”.

Summary

The Director, Infrastructure is a senior technology leader responsible for the strategic planning, design, governance, implementation, security, availability, and continuous improvement of the firm's infrastructure and engineering systems. This role leads firmwide infrastructure strategy and operations across 60+ locations, ensuring secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-effective services that support attorneys, clients, administrative departments, and business operations. The Director partners closely with the CIO and IT leadership to translate firm strategy, client expectations, security requirements, and legal service delivery needs into a practical multi-year technology roadmap.

The Director provides leadership for infrastructure engineering and operations, services, data center and network operations, endpoint and collaboration platforms, service reliability, disaster recovery, vendor performance, managed service provider accountability, and modernization initiatives. The role is expected to maintain high availability and performance for mission-critical legal technology platforms, support secure adoption of cloud and AI-enabled productivity capabilities, and communicate effectively with executive, attorney, business services, technical, and vendor stakeholders. The position requires strong law firm or professional services judgment, strict confidentiality, operational discipline, and the ability to translate legal business needs into practical technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure and cloud services roadmap aligned with the firm’s strategic priorities, risk posture, budget objectives, growth plans, and service expectations.
Lead the design, governance, delivery, and ongoing support of core infrastructure services, including Microsoft cloud platforms, data centers, server and virtualization environments, storage, backup, disaster recovery, network, telephony, endpoint, collaboration, and hybrid connectivity.

Drive modernization of legacy systems and services toward secure, scalable, cloud-enabled, automated, and operationally sustainable platforms while maintaining appropriate controls for legal data, client confidentiality, retention, and compliance.
Oversee Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Defender, Purview, and related firm-managed cloud services, with accountability for governance, configuration standards, performance, monitoring, cost management, licensing, and adoption planning.
Ensure reliable, secure connectivity across all offices, remote users, and critical firm services through effective oversight of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, DNS, DHCP, identity, access management, and network segmentation practices.
Establish and maintain infrastructure standards, operating practices, documentation requirements, service health metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and executive reporting that demonstrate platform reliability, user experience, operational risk, and progress against roadmap commitments.
Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning for infrastructure services, including documented runbooks, recovery objectives, testing, remediation tracking, and reporting.
Partner with Information Security, Records, Compliance, Applications, Practice Technology, Knowledge Management, Litigation Support, Training, Office Administration, and Service Desk teams to deliver integrated, reliable, and secure technology services.
Support the technical readiness of new offices, major site expansions, integrations, and significant technology transitions, including connectivity, conference room technology, endpoint infrastructure, printing, telephony, documentation, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization.
Ensure infrastructure and cloud platforms meet applicable cybersecurity specifications, firm policies, client requirements, legal industry expectations, audit needs, cyber insurance requirements, and regulatory obligations related to confidentiality, integrity, availability, and data protection.
Participate in incident, problem, and change management practices, ensuring appropriate testing, communications, approvals, escalation, back-out planning, root-cause analysis, and post-implementation review.
Lead, mentor, and develop internal team members and managed service resources, setting clear priorities, accountability, documentation expectations, service standards, and a culture of customer service, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Manage strategic vendors, managed service providers, contracts, service levels, renewals, performance reviews, licensing discussions, escalation processes, roadmap alignment, and ongoing accountability for service quality and cost effectiveness.
Develop and manage infrastructure budgets in partnership with IT and Finance leadership, including capital planning, operating spend, forecasting, renewals, cost optimization, and business cases for major investments.
Communicate risks, priorities, progress, service metrics, investment needs, and recommendations clearly to IT leadership, firm leadership, attorneys, business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive IT experience across infrastructure, cloud, network, enterprise operations, or related technology services, including significant experience leading teams, programs, vendors, or managed services.
5+ years in a leadership role with responsibility for strategic planning, people leadership, service delivery, budgets, vendor management, project execution, and operational accountability.
Experience in a law firm, legal services organization, or professional services environment strongly preferred, with demonstrated appreciation for confidentiality, client service, time-sensitive workflows, and risk-sensitive technology operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting mission-critical business technology environments, including document management, collaboration, secure file sharing, practice management, eDiscovery, records, or related legal business platforms.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud services, Azure/hybrid cloud, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, identity and access management, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, Defender, Purview, Windows Server, virtualization, storage, backup, networking, and data center operations.
Proven ability to develop and execute multi-year roadmaps, enterprise standards, cloud governance models, operational runbooks, disaster recovery plans, and modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, problem, change, asset, configuration, service level, and knowledge management.
Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent projects and operational demands across a large multi-office environment while maintaining service quality, documentation, risk visibility, and executive-level communication.
Proven ability to work effectively with executives, attorneys, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and managed service providers.
Strong judgment, critical thinking, financial discipline, and ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, client service, security, risk reduction, and operational resiliency.

For NY Metro, San Francisco Metro and Los Angeles Metro area, the expected salary range for this position is between $216,250,000 and $252,250. This position is also eligible for annual bonuses. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

Jackson Lewis offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
401(k) Retirement Plan
Flexible Spending & Health Savings Account
firm-paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
Employee assistance program and other benefits

For Illinois, the expected salary range for this position is between $198,250 and $231,250. This position is also eligible for annual bonuses. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Sr. Manager, Software Engineering

About Your Role

At Fiserv, we are dedicated to transforming financial services technology to benefit our clients. As a Manager Software Development II, you will lead a team of talented developers to create innovative solutions that address complex business challenges. Your role will involve overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software applications, ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality projects.

What You'll Do

Lead and manage a team of software developers, providing direction and guidance to ensure successful project delivery.
Oversee the design, development, and implementation of software applications that align with Fiserv's strategic goals.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure timely and on-budget delivery.
Provide mentorship and professional development opportunities for team members.
Foster a collaborative and innovative work environment.
Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience You'll Need To Have

6+ years of experience in software development
3+ years of experience leading teams
3+ years of experience in Java, C, C#, C++, or similar programming languages
3+ years of experience in SQL databases
3+ years of experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP services
3+ years of experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
3+ years of experience with Agile methodologies
6+ years of an equivalent combination of educational background, related experience, and/or military experience

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

Experience in the financial services industry

$160,000.00 - $240,000.00

jobs.title: Director, ServiceNow Engineering (R-19848)
jobs.description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at  dnb.com/careers .

Director, ServiceNow Engineering (hands-on) is responsible for leading the overall development activities of the ServiceNow Platform. The leader needs enough technical depth to challenge designs, estimate work, make architecture decisions and develop/configure as needed. Along with leading a team of highly skilled engineers.

The Director, ServiceNow Engineering will work with various ServiceNow Process Owners and Technology Operations teams to understand their needs and propose appropriate architecture/design for implementation. As the leader of the team, this role will work with the team to grow their skills, drive opportunities of platform adoption, and focus on engineering excellence. 

Essential Responsibilities:

Drive Core Engineering Excellence to ensure we build, run and operate the ServiceNow Platform and core products with high Availability, Resiliency and operational insights.

Develop and execute on project plan and timelines, manage budgets with our cloud provides and manage the relationships with internal and external partners.

Collaborate with various stakeholders to understand their needs and propose appropriate architecture/design for implementation.

Identify areas for growth with a focus on software development testing and automation.

Drive automation with AI and other ServiceNow automation features while ensuring the right levels of testing and code quality checks are in place.

Serve as a coach and mentor to platform architects, engineers, and platform product/process owners.

Essential Skills Needed:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields.

Minimum of 8 years of leadership experience on the ServiceNow Platform.

Understand platform architecture, data models, tables, relationships, scoped applications, integrations, security, upgrade implications, and platform limits.

The ability to break technical requirements into technical components, identify dependencies/complexity, estimate developer effort, and challenge estimates from the team partners.

JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, REST/SOAP APIs, ACLs, UI configurations, debugging and performance trouble shooting.

Understanding how major products/capabilities interact (not necessarily be the SME for every module).

Strong knowledge of Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Knowledge, Service Operations Workspace, CMDB and related workflows.

Understand CI relationships, Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, identification/reconciliation, and data quality.

Establish development standards, code reviews, technical governance, release controls and guardrails to prevent unnecessary customization.

Recognize poor queries, inefficient scripting, excessive automation, integration bottlenecks and other platform performance risks.

Understand Now Assist, GenAI capabilities, AI agents, skills, use cases, governance, security, and value realization.

Source control, update sets/app repo, automated testing (APM), CI/CD, cloning, environment strategy, release, and upgrades.

Challenge partner designs, estimates, staffing models, and technical recommendations rather than rely on vendors for technical direction.

Hire, coach and develop engineers; establish expectations; conduct performance reviews.

Demonstrate clear and effective verbal and written communication skills with all levels of staff.

Ability to resolve problems quickly as they arise and lead through obscurity of these problems and build solutions for future.

Demonstrated experience in leading people and working with diverse development teams.

Show an ownership mindset in everything you do. Be a problem solver, be curious and be inspired to take action. Be proactive, seek ways to collaborate and connect with people and teams in support of driving success.

Continuous growth mindset, keep learning through social experiences and relationships with stakeholders, experts, colleagues and mentors as well as widen and broaden your competencies through structural courses and programs.

Benefits We Offer

· Generous paid time off in your first year, increasing with tenure.

· Up to 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave after one year of employment.

· Paid sick time to care for yourself or family members. 

· Education assistance and extensive training resources.

· Do Good Program: Paid volunteer days & donation matching.  

· Competitive 401k with company matching.

· Health & wellness benefits, including discounted Wellhub membership rates.

· Medical, dental & vision insurance for you, spouse/partner & dependents.

Responsible for overall department growth and performance. Ensures the Transportation department maintains coordination with other departments and alignment with Company protocols and procedures. Accountable for overall client satisfaction of the department, financial forecasting and performance, and Quality Control/Quality Assurance. Oversee the department’s proposal development and interviews for a range of project sizes and types
Lead and direct the department’s business development and other strategic growth initiatives; actively participate in industry, networking, and professional organizations events and activities

jobs.title: Senior Manager, TBM Platform & Cloud FinOps
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At HUB International, we are a team of entrepreneurs. We believe in protecting and supporting the aspirations of individuals, families, and businesses. We help our clients evaluate their risks and develop solutions tailored to their needs. We believe in empowering our employees to learn, grow, and make a difference. Our structure enables our teams to maintain their own unique, regional culture while leveraging support and resources from our corporate centers of excellence.
HUB is a global insurance and employee benefits broker, providing a boundaryless array of business insurance, employee benefits, risk services, personal insurance, retirement, and private wealth management products and services. With over $5 billion in revenue and almost 20,000 employees in 600 offices throughout North America, HUB has grown substantially, in part due to our industry leading success in mergers and acquisitions

We are hiring a Manager/Senior Manager to join our Enterprise Strategy and Technology Planning function, with dual responsibility for managing our Apptio Technology Business Management (TBM) platform and leading Cloud Financial Operations (FinOps). Reporting to the Director of Technology Business Management, sets direction and owns outcomes for both disciplines, directing a team that includes an Apptio platform team and an internal Cloud FinOps Lead. The role is accountable for strategy execution, quality of delivery, and stakeholder alignment rather than day-to-day system configuration.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in TBM frameworks, Apptio tooling, and Cloud FinOps practices, combined with strong financial acumen and the ability to collaborate across diverse stakeholder groups. This role requires someone who can set priorities, hold delivery partners accountable, and translate technology and cloud spend into insights business and technology leaders can action.

In This Role, You’ll Get To:

Team Leadership & Strategy Execution

Lead and direct a team comprising the TBM platform team and Cloud FinOps Lead, setting priorities and holding both accountable to roadmap commitments
Translate enterprise TBM strategy into an executable roadmap for TBM Platform and Cloud FinOps, in partnership with the Director of TBM

Apptio Platform Oversight

Set direction and priorities for Apptio module build-out (Planning, TCO, Cost Allocation, Vendor Management), directing the TBM platform team's execution
Ensure system integrity, data quality, and alignment to TBM best practices across the Apptio platform
Oversee delivery of executive-level financial reporting and dashboards, including CIO-level visibility into technology spend, trends, and KPIs

Cloud FinOps Leadership

Direct the Cloud FinOps Lead in maturing cloud cost allocation, optimization, and FinOps practices across Cloudability
Set the roadmap for cloud cost transparency and drive FinOps adoption with infrastructure and product teams

Cross-Functional Partnership & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the senior point of contact for Technology leaders and finance team on Apptio and Cloud FinOps matters
Partner with Corporate Finance to integrate Apptio outputs into enterprise financial reporting and planning cycles
Represent Apptio and Cloud FinOps strategy and progress to the Director and senior leadership

Governance & Continuous Improvement

Establish governance frameworks and standard operating procedures for the Apptio platform and Cloud FinOps function
Drive automation, data integration improvements, and organizational adoption through team-led training and enablement

We Are Looking for Someone with the Following Competencies:

- TBM & Apptio Strategy
— strong grasp of TBM frameworks and Apptio capabilities sufficient to direct a platform team, set priorities, and evaluate delivery quality; hands-on configuration is not required
- Cloud FinOps Leadership
— understanding of cloud pricing models, optimization techniques, and FinOps principles, with experience directing FinOps practice maturity
- Team & Vendor Management
— proven experience leading teams and directing third-party or managed-service delivery
- IT Financial Planning & Analysis
— solid understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and translating technology costs into financial narratives
- Stakeholder Management & Executive Communication
— skilled at engaging technology and finance audiences and presenting to senior leadership
- Change Management & User Enablement
— track record driving adoption of new tools and ways of working across an organization

Required Experience:
-7+ years of professional experience in IT Finance, Technology Business
-Management, FP&A, or related roles, including experience leading teams and/or managing vendor delivery
-Experience directing or partnering with Apptio (or a similar TBM platform) implementation; hands-on configuration experience is a plus but not required
-Experience with Cloud FinOps practices and tools such as Cloudability
-Proven track record leading teams and managing external delivery partners
-Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or related field required
-MBA, CPA, or TBM Certified Professional preferred
-Strong financial acumen; familiarity with financial systems (e.g., Oracle, Workday, SAP)

JOIN OUR TEAM

Do you believe in the power of innovation, collaboration, and transformation? Do you thrive in a supportive and client focused work environment? Are you looking for an opportunity to help build and drive change in a rapidly growing and evolving organization? When you join HUB International
, you will be part of a community of learners and doers focused on our Core Values: entrepreneurship, teamwork, integrity, accountability, and service.

Disclosure required under applicable law in California, Colorado, Illinois, Maryland, Minnesota, New York, New Jersey, Ohio, and Washington states: The expected salary range for this position is $135,000-$165,000 and will be impacted by factors such as the successful candidate’s skills, experience and working location, as well as the specific position’s business line, scope and level. HUB International is proud to offer comprehensive benefit and total compensation packages: health/dental/vision/life/disability insurance, FSA, HSA and 401(k) accounts, paid-time-off benefits such as vacation, sick, and personal days, and eligible bonuses, equity and commissions for some positions.

jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Focused on employment and labor law since 1958, Jackson Lewis P.C.’s 1,000+ attorneys located in major cities nationwide consistently identify and respond to new ways workplace law intersects business. We help employers develop proactive strategies, strong policies and business-oriented solutions to cultivate high-functioning workforces that are engaged and stable, and share our clients’ goals to emphasize belonging and respect for the contributions of every employee.

The Firm is ranked in the First Tier nationally in the category of Labor and Employment Litigation, as well as in both Employment Law and Labor Law on behalf of Management, in the U.S. News - Best Lawyers® “Best Law Firms”.

Summary

The Director, Infrastructure is a senior technology leader responsible for the strategic planning, design, governance, implementation, security, availability, and continuous improvement of the firm's infrastructure and engineering systems. This role leads firmwide infrastructure strategy and operations across 60+ locations, ensuring secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-effective services that support attorneys, clients, administrative departments, and business operations. The Director partners closely with the CIO and IT leadership to translate firm strategy, client expectations, security requirements, and legal service delivery needs into a practical multi-year technology roadmap.

The Director provides leadership for infrastructure engineering and operations, services, data center and network operations, endpoint and collaboration platforms, service reliability, disaster recovery, vendor performance, managed service provider accountability, and modernization initiatives. The role is expected to maintain high availability and performance for mission-critical legal technology platforms, support secure adoption of cloud and AI-enabled productivity capabilities, and communicate effectively with executive, attorney, business services, technical, and vendor stakeholders. The position requires strong law firm or professional services judgment, strict confidentiality, operational discipline, and the ability to translate legal business needs into practical technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure and cloud services roadmap aligned with the firm’s strategic priorities, risk posture, budget objectives, growth plans, and service expectations.
Lead the design, governance, delivery, and ongoing support of core infrastructure services, including Microsoft cloud platforms, data centers, server and virtualization environments, storage, backup, disaster recovery, network, telephony, endpoint, collaboration, and hybrid connectivity.

Drive modernization of legacy systems and services toward secure, scalable, cloud-enabled, automated, and operationally sustainable platforms while maintaining appropriate controls for legal data, client confidentiality, retention, and compliance.
Oversee Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Defender, Purview, and related firm-managed cloud services, with accountability for governance, configuration standards, performance, monitoring, cost management, licensing, and adoption planning.
Ensure reliable, secure connectivity across all offices, remote users, and critical firm services through effective oversight of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, DNS, DHCP, identity, access management, and network segmentation practices.
Establish and maintain infrastructure standards, operating practices, documentation requirements, service health metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and executive reporting that demonstrate platform reliability, user experience, operational risk, and progress against roadmap commitments.
Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning for infrastructure services, including documented runbooks, recovery objectives, testing, remediation tracking, and reporting.
Partner with Information Security, Records, Compliance, Applications, Practice Technology, Knowledge Management, Litigation Support, Training, Office Administration, and Service Desk teams to deliver integrated, reliable, and secure technology services.
Support the technical readiness of new offices, major site expansions, integrations, and significant technology transitions, including connectivity, conference room technology, endpoint infrastructure, printing, telephony, documentation, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization.
Ensure infrastructure and cloud platforms meet applicable cybersecurity specifications, firm policies, client requirements, legal industry expectations, audit needs, cyber insurance requirements, and regulatory obligations related to confidentiality, integrity, availability, and data protection.
Participate in incident, problem, and change management practices, ensuring appropriate testing, communications, approvals, escalation, back-out planning, root-cause analysis, and post-implementation review.
Lead, mentor, and develop internal team members and managed service resources, setting clear priorities, accountability, documentation expectations, service standards, and a culture of customer service, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Manage strategic vendors, managed service providers, contracts, service levels, renewals, performance reviews, licensing discussions, escalation processes, roadmap alignment, and ongoing accountability for service quality and cost effectiveness.
Develop and manage infrastructure budgets in partnership with IT and Finance leadership, including capital planning, operating spend, forecasting, renewals, cost optimization, and business cases for major investments.
Communicate risks, priorities, progress, service metrics, investment needs, and recommendations clearly to IT leadership, firm leadership, attorneys, business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive IT experience across infrastructure, cloud, network, enterprise operations, or related technology services, including significant experience leading teams, programs, vendors, or managed services.
5+ years in a leadership role with responsibility for strategic planning, people leadership, service delivery, budgets, vendor management, project execution, and operational accountability.
Experience in a law firm, legal services organization, or professional services environment strongly preferred, with demonstrated appreciation for confidentiality, client service, time-sensitive workflows, and risk-sensitive technology operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting mission-critical business technology environments, including document management, collaboration, secure file sharing, practice management, eDiscovery, records, or related legal business platforms.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud services, Azure/hybrid cloud, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, identity and access management, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, Defender, Purview, Windows Server, virtualization, storage, backup, networking, and data center operations.
Proven ability to develop and execute multi-year roadmaps, enterprise standards, cloud governance models, operational runbooks, disaster recovery plans, and modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, problem, change, asset, configuration, service level, and knowledge management.
Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent projects and operational demands across a large multi-office environment while maintaining service quality, documentation, risk visibility, and executive-level communication.

Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com

As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.

Job Function

R&D Product Development

Job Sub Function

R&D Software/Systems Engineering

Job Category

People Leader

All Job Posting Locations:

Boston, Massachusetts, United States of America

Job Description

About Orthopaedics

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments.

Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of Orthopaedics? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal? Our Orthopaedics teams help keep more than 6 million people moving each year while delivering clinical and economic value to surgeons and healthcare systems. Our teams build solutions for joint reconstruction; trauma and craniomaxillofacial; sports, extremities, and elective foot and ankle; spine; and robotics and digital surgery.

Your unique talents will help patients on their journey to wellness. Learn more at https://www.jnj.com/medtech

We are searching for the best talent for Director R&D Software Navigation to be based out of Boston, MA

Purpose

The Director R&D Software Navigation will lead a growing software team responsible for delivering next generation surgical navigation systems. This role is a critical technical and people leadership position within Navigation Systems R&D for 5 platforms, combining deep expertise with strategic ownership of software architecture, execution, and quality.

This role is accountable for leading a team of Software Engineers and is responsible for defining, building, and sustaining robust, scalable, and safety critical software platforms that meet clinical, user, and regulatory requirements. Working closely with systems, hardware, clinical, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory partners, this role ensures that software solutions are architected and executed to meet system level performance, safety, and reliability objectives.

This position requires a functional & technical leader who can operate effectively in a highly regulated, multidisciplinary surgical environment, while mentoring teams, driving innovation, and enabling predictable, high quality delivery.

Job Responsibilities

Lead the full lifecycle development of software subsystems for surgical navigation platforms, from early concept and prototyping through verification, release, and post market support.
Collaborate with senior engineers and architects to define, own, and evolve the software platform and architecture, ensuring scalability, real time performance, safety, cybersecurity, and long term maintainability.
Establish technical direction and software roadmaps aligned with product strategy and system evolution.
Ensure software designs are compliant with system requirements, user needs, intended use, hazard mitigations, and regulatory expectations.
Partner with systems engineering, hardware, clinical, usability/human factors, quality, and manufacturing teams to translate user needs into clear, testable, traceable software requirements.
Lead and participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, and cross disciplinary technical trade off discussions.
Collaborate on the design and implementation of safe, intuitive user interfaces with human factors and clinical teams.
Support regulatory submissions, audits, inspections, and DHF completeness in partnership with quality and regulatory affairs.
Support controlled release pipelines aligned with design controls and change management
Lead adoption of automated unit-testing, integration, and system level testing to improve quality and delivery predictability.
Champion metrics driven development (build health, test coverage, defect trends) to drive continuous improvement.
Lead software FMEA activities, define and verify effective risk mitigation strategies, and ensure software safety levels align with system requirements and applicable risk controls.
Contribute to hazard analysis, risk management, and design controls in accordance with medical device regulations.
Ensure compliance with applicable medical device software standards (e.g., IEC 62304) and internal quality processes.
Investigate non conformances, deviations, and test failures; drive root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective actions.
Support design transfer, manufacturing readiness, and product launch activities.
Participate in complaint investigations, post market surveillance, and controlled software updates.
Build, mentor, and retain a high performing full-stack software team.
Support resource planning, staffing, and schedule estimation.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
Identify and communicate business related issues, risks, and opportunities to senior management in a timely and effective manner.
Interface with regulatory, quality, and manufacturing teams to support audits and inspections.
Ensure that subordinates follow all Company guidelines related to Health, Safety and Environmental practices and that all resources needed to do so are available and in good condition, if applicable
Responsible for ensuring personal and Company compliance with all Federal, State, local and Company regulations, policies, and procedures
Performs other duties assigned as needed
Identify critical paths during product development, address bottlenecks and risks and facilitate problem solving across R&D teams.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
10+ years: Developing software from concept through commercial release (SaMD experience preferred)
7+ years: Directly managing a software team of more than 10 developers while acting as the main functional manager & technical point of contact
Significant, demonstratable hands-on experience in more than one of the following technologies: .NET/C#, Python, Java, Front-End technologies (WPF, JS/TS, React, etc.), Scripting (Powershell, Batch)
Significant experience leading concurrent project teams of multiple software engineers using Agile-Scrum methodology.
Proven experience managing and directing the day-to-day work of more than 10 SW developers
Proven experience as the Lead decision maker of software design based on end-to-end knowledge impacts
Strong understanding of software and systems engineering principles
Proven experience authoring technical documentation (preferably in a highly regulated environment)

Preferred

Performing annual individual performance reviews and developing S.M.A.R.T goals for software developers
Translating user requirements from Medical professionals into actionable software development tasks
Writing technical documentation in a regulated medical industry
AI/ML model implementation in SAMD production systems
Complex problem solving
Global release and support of production systems used by external customers

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.
401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting
Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year
11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan
Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year
$500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year
Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month
Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month
Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Product Manager to own the Platform product suite — the foundational capabilities, control plane, and developer tools that customers use to provision, manage, automate, and govern their infrastructure. This includes Vultr's REST APIs, Console, CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, Billing, Account Activity, Audit Logs, Regions, IAM, Sub Accounts, Admin, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets. Together these products form the platform layer that every Vultr customer interacts with and that every infrastructure product depends on to reach customers. The ideal candidate brings deep technical fluency in platform engineering, API design, and developer experience, combined with a strong product instinct for building tools that make infrastructure feel effortless. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require close partnership with Compute, Network, Storage, Security, and AI teams to ensure every new infrastructure launch is programmable, governed, and intuitive from day one. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of independent cloud infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

Own the end-to-end Platform product suite roadmap — covering developer surfaces (REST APIs, Console, CLI, SDKs, Terraform provider, ISOs) and account-level capabilities (Billing, Account Activity, Audit Logs, Regions, IAM, Sub Accounts, Admin, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets)
Define Vultr's platform and developer experience strategy aligned to infrastructure roadmap, reliability goals, and the needs of both digital-native builders and enterprise customers adopting the cloud
Drive the customer-facing platform surface across APIs, Console UI, CLI, SDKs — ensuring consistency, completeness, and a coherent experience across all touchpoints
Own the API as a product — define versioning strategy, deprecation policy, rate limiting, pagination, error handling, and authentication flows that make Vultr's API a first-class developer experience
Own the Console as a product — drive the web-based control plane experience, working with design and frontend engineering to make complex infrastructure operations intuitive and efficient
Own the Terraform provider, CLI, and SDKs — ensure our infrastructure-as-code and programmatic tooling stays current with API changes and represents best-in-class developer tooling practices
Own the account management and governance product surface — Billing, IAM, Sub Accounts, Audit Logs, and Admin tools that give customers control over access, spending, and compliance posture
Own the operational product surface — Regions, Instance Templates, Custom Images, Startup Scripts, SSH Keys, and Support Tickets that customers use daily to manage and automate their infrastructure at scale
Work closely with engineering on technical tradeoffs across API design, authentication flows, rate limiting, caching strategies, SDK generation, CLI architecture, and Console frontend performance
Build products for two customer profiles — digital-native builders who want speed and simplicity, and enterprise adopters who need IAM, audit trails, sub-account governance, and programmatic control
Ensure new infrastructure and platform launches are API-first and Console-ready by design through strong partnership with compute, network, storage, security, and AI teams
Define and measure platform health metrics — API availability, latency, error rates, SDK adoption, Console task completion rates, CLI active usage, and developer satisfaction
Stay current on modern platform engineering trends, including API design patterns, SDK generation, developer portals, infrastructure-as-code, identity and access management, and the evolving state of cloud developer experience

Qualifications

7+ years of product management experience in cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, infrastructure-as-code, or API products
Deep understanding of platform engineering — you've designed, shipped, or maintained APIs, CLIs, SDKs, or developer tools at scale
Experience defining product strategy and roadmaps for platform or developer-facing products at scale
Experience with cloud account management and governance products — billing, IAM, audit logging, sub-accounts, or equivalent enterprise access control systems
Strong technical background — ability to engage with engineering on API design, authentication flows, rate limiting, SDK architecture, and frontend performance
Experience with infrastructure-as-code ecosystems — Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or similar
Track record of shipping developer-facing products with measurable impact on adoption, task completion time, or developer satisfaction
Experience with cloud provider platforms — you've worked on or extensively used AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean, Linode, or similar. You know what good and bad cloud UX feels like
Experience with API lifecycle management — versioning, deprecation, backward compatibility, and developer communication
Experience working across cross-functional teams (engineering, design, marketing, sales) in a fast-paced environment
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for diverse audiences
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Compensation

$180,000 - $200,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

The role is expected to maintain high availability and performance for mission-critical legal technology platforms, support secure adoption of cloud and AI-enabled productivity capabilities, and communicate effectively with executive, attorney, business services, technical, and vendor stakeholders. Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure and cloud services roadmap aligned with the firm’s strategic priorities, risk posture, budget objectives, growth plans, and service expectations.
Lead the design, governance, delivery, and ongoing support of core infrastructure services, including Microsoft cloud platforms, data centers, server and virtualization environments, storage, backup, disaster recovery, network, telephony, endpoint, collaboration, and hybrid connectivity.

Drive modernization of legacy systems and services toward secure, scalable, cloud-enabled, automated, and operationally sustainable platforms while maintaining appropriate controls for legal data, client confidentiality, retention, and compliance.
Oversee Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Defender, Purview, and related firm-managed cloud services, with accountability for governance, configuration standards, performance, monitoring, cost management, licensing, and adoption planning.
Ensure reliable, secure connectivity across all offices, remote users, and critical firm services through effective oversight of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, DNS, DHCP, identity, access management, and network segmentation practices.
Establish and maintain infrastructure standards, operating practices, documentation requirements, service health metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and executive reporting that demonstrate platform reliability, user experience, operational risk, and progress against roadmap commitments.
Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning for infrastructure services, including documented runbooks, recovery objectives, testing, remediation tracking, and reporting.
Partner with Information Security, Records, Compliance, Applications, Practice Technology, Knowledge Management, Litigation Support, Training, Office Administration, and Service Desk teams to deliver integrated, reliable, and secure technology services.
Support the technical readiness of new offices, major site expansions, integrations, and significant technology transitions, including connectivity, conference room technology, endpoint infrastructure, printing, telephony, documentation, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization.
Ensure infrastructure and cloud platforms meet applicable cybersecurity specifications, firm policies, client requirements, legal industry expectations, audit needs, cyber insurance requirements, and regulatory obligations related to confidentiality, integrity, availability, and data protection.
Participate in incident, problem, and change management practices, ensuring appropriate testing, communications, approvals, escalation, back-out planning, root-cause analysis, and post-implementation review.
Lead, mentor, and develop internal team members and managed service resources, setting clear priorities, accountability, documentation expectations, service standards, and a culture of customer service, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Develop and manage infrastructure budgets in partnership with IT and Finance leadership, including capital planning, operating spend, forecasting, renewals, cost optimization, and business cases for major investments.
Communicate risks, priorities, progress, service metrics, investment needs, and recommendations clearly to IT leadership, firm leadership, attorneys, business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

10+ years of progressive IT experience across infrastructure, cloud, network, enterprise operations, or related technology services, including significant experience leading teams, programs, vendors, or managed services.
5+ years in a leadership role with responsibility for strategic planning, people leadership, service delivery, budgets, vendor management, project execution, and operational accountability.
Experience in a law firm, legal services organization, or professional services environment strongly preferred, with demonstrated appreciation for confidentiality, client service, time-sensitive workflows, and risk-sensitive technology operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting mission-critical business technology environments, including document management, collaboration, secure file sharing, practice management, eDiscovery, records, or related legal business platforms.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud services, Azure/hybrid cloud, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, identity and access management, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, Defender, Purview, Windows Server, virtualization, storage, backup, networking, and data center operations.
Proven ability to develop and execute multi-year roadmaps, enterprise standards, cloud governance models, operational runbooks, disaster recovery plans, and modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, problem, change, asset, configuration, service level, and knowledge management.

Proven ability to work effectively with executives, attorneys, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and managed service providers.
Strong judgment, critical thinking, financial discipline, and ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, client service, security, risk reduction, and operational resiliency.

Communications
Prepare and deliver messages that achieve the intended results.
Promote Engineering information and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders (Corporate Director of Engineering, Engineering Associates, General Associate Body, Managers, Executive Team, Asset Owner, Homeowner Association, Master Association, Residential Owners)
Prepare reports for stakeholders
Manage stakeholder perceptions and expectations

Quality Control
Manage/oversee the application of standards for the hotel/resort.
Review and compare performance metrics for Engineering services
Maintain specifications (materials, equipment, furniture, finishes, fixtures, design criteria).
Develop, implement and monitor best practices.
Develop guest service standards.

Measure the quality of services provided.
Monitor guest satisfaction and service delivery performance.
Collect, verify, analyze and report facility management data from various sources (guest satisfaction surveys, secret shop inspections, other feedback mechanisms).
Collect and verify, analyze and report internal facility management data (utilities, work orders, work history).

Manage/oversee the improvement of work processes.
Assess ways to improve workplace productivity.
Develop and implement process improvements.

Ensure and monitor compliance with codes, regulations, policies and standards.

Technology
Plan, direct and manage/oversee facility management business and operational technologies.
Assess the application of technology within facility operations.
Operate workplace management systems (CMMS, BAS, Lighting Controls).

Operations & Maintenance
Assess the condition of the hotel/resort.
Manage/oversee the assessment of building systems’ condition.
Assess the condition of the facility’s structure, interior, exterior and grounds.

Manage/oversee facility operations and maintenance activities.
Manage/oversee the acquisition, installation, operation, maintenance and disposal of building systems and structural, interior, exterior and grounds elements.
Maintain basic knowledge of current products and technology for fixed assets.

Manage/oversee the maintenance contracting process.
Decide/recommend the most appropriate way to provide maintenance services (outsource, in-source).
Develop maintenance contract specifications.
Assure competent maintenance contractors are selected.
Negotiate service level agreements.
Manage/oversee the modifications to building systems, structural elements, interiors, exteriors and grounds.
Monitor the performance of maintenance contractors’ work.
Resolve contract disputes.

Develop, recommend and manage/oversee the hotel/resort’s operational planning requirements (temperature control, lighting, equipment replacement and so forth).
Develop policies and guidelines related to usage and maintenance.
Monitor the usage and performance of all systems, equipment and grounds.
Monitor guest and associate satisfaction.

Manage and oversee the financial management of the Engineering department.
Develop, recommend, manage and oversee the Engineering and Utilities operating budget requirements.
Develop, recommend, manage and oversee the capital budget requirements.
Prepare business cases, supporting documentation and financial reports.

Develop and manage contracts.
Administer and monitor contracts.
Resolve vendor conflicts.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description:
About Nexcess

Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.

Overview

You will run and own the product engineering organization end to end: their architecture,

delivery,

and

engineering roadmap

. You are here to build and enable an engineering organization that

ships fast and reliably

, and how much of it is AI-efficiently enabled.

How We Work

Business alignment and focus come first.

Engineering here exists to move the business.

Key Performance Indicators

Speed: DORA metrics with High/Elite as the target.
Predictable, reliable delivery of quality software.
AI adoption and its impact.

Responsibilities

Product and delivery

Own architecture design, delivery and engineering roadmap for your teams. Build the partnership with Product: shape it together, commit to it, and then deliver it.
Run delivery on monthly cycles with an explicit cut line. Scope, design and deliver demonstrable value each month. Your teams must have an evidence backed ability to meet commitments rather than explained afterwards.

Organization and people

Design teams that deliver. Draw team boundaries so a team can finish its work without waiting on any other team. One accountable Engineering Manager per team, so the owner of any piece of work is known the moment it arrives.
Build the manager bench. Hire, develop, and calibrate engineering managers, own the hiring bar, and know who is ready to run each team. Coach them to lead rather than code.

Qualifications

Required

12+ years in software engineering, including 5+ leading engineering teams, and experience leading managers.
Evidence you have made an engineering organization measurably faster. You instrumented DORA or an equivalent, you know your before-and-after numbers, and can walk through what you changed and what broke while it settled.
Real, hands-on AI-assisted engineering at organizational scale, with impact you can quantify. Not a pilot and not a vendor rollout: adoption driven across teams, agentic tooling you use yourself every week, your own harness you can describe, and a clear view of where it fails and what to verify. Bring the evidence: the harness you run, a skill you wrote and shared, a spec an agent executed, the review gates you shipped.
Experience redesigning how teams and work are organized: boundaries, ownership, cadence, and living with the result.
Delivered and modernized complex software through multiple teams, including reassessing scope or dates with senior stakeholders and absorbing the consequences.
Hands-on enough to review a design, read a change and hold a defensible technical position without owning the implementation.
Owned a hiring plan end to end and held a bar; run software in production with real accountability for availability; led remote teams across time zones with vendor squads inside them, on agreements you shaped.
Managed hosting, cloud or another high-availability service business is a must.

Hard Skills

Depth in any single technology matters less than the judgment to specify, verify and decide; AI supplies the syntax and the reference. These are the areas we will test that judgment in.

AI-native engineering. Agentic coding tools as your daily instrument and a harness you designed: repository instructions, shared skills, tool connectors, permission boundaries. Specification-first working, automated review in the pull-request path, a defensible position on what may be auto-approved, and quota and cost governance.
The delivery system. DORA instrumented and moved, tests on every change with coverage gating, trunk-based delivery and feature flags, observability and service levels, one tracker with one intake door, incident command with actions closed on dates.
Long-lived cores. Leading change on twenty-year Perl and PHP monoliths without writing either: strangler seams behind an API gateway, an identity issuer and an event bus, characterization tests before change, a system of record chosen where there are two of everything, and knowing what not to rewrite.
Revenue-bearing systems. Billing and payments consolidation across processors, Stripe among them: dual-run, reconciliation to Finance, and a rollback you prepared.
Hosting platforms. cPanel and InterWorx, the control panel we develop ourselves; WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento and Shopware above them; Linux on bare metal, and a VMware to Nutanix migration that product delivery has to sequence around.
Security in an AI-assisted SDLC. Secrets hygiene and push protection, static analysis in the merge path, the tool and connector supply chain, prompt injection through repository content.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Thrive Capital, Ribbit, and Khosla Ventures, we're building a world-class team to redefine how people pay and how brands grow. If you want to move fast, solve hard problems, and own real outcomes, we want to meet you.

Engineering leadership is the lever for this next stage. As Imprint expands into new financial products, launches new brand partnerships, and scales the infrastructure underneath all of it, the quality of our engineering teams determines the quality of everything we ship. AI has made execution faster; the differentiator is the judgment to decide what to build, how to sequence it, and when to say no. That judgment, applied to how teams are built, how they make decisions, and how they're managed, is what Senior Engineering Managers own.

The Opportunity

Bring structure to complex, ambiguous domains: Imprint's products sit at the intersection of payments, credit, compliance, and brand strategy. You'll lead a team through problems that aren't fully scoped, where the right answer requires synthesizing technical constraints with product, legal, and financial realities.
Operate as a true cross-functional partner: Not just "align with product." You'll work directly with product, compliance, legal, capital markets, and solutions engineering on decisions where the lanes overlap significantly. You will help represent Engineering in the room when strategy is set.
Lead with technical credibility, amplified by AI: AI has collapsed the distance between management and IC work. Managers at Imprint use AI tools to investigate codebases, assess the complexity and viability of work, and bring clarity to ambiguous asks. You don't need to be on the critical path writing code (though some managers are), but you need real technical judgment and the modern tools to exercise it.
Build and develop a team as a craft: You have a real philosophy on how to hire, develop, and retain strong engineers. You have opinions on how work is scoped and delivered, how to balance short and long-term priorities, and how to give feedback that actually changes outcomes. Clear communication, written and verbal, is key.
Operate in the details: This is not a role where technical context and project management are abstracted to other roles or organizational layers. You define the roadmap, scope the work, and manage individuals to outcomes. Even if you've led multiple teams before, the question is: can you take a new team and run it end-to-end?
Own outcomes at a company in a defining growth moment: Imprint is growing rapidly, launching new products, and deepening our platform. You'll have the scope and autonomy to shape how your team builds, and your work will be visible in the trajectory of the business.

Your Profile

5+ years of engineering management experience, with a track record of building, developing, and retaining strong engineering teams
You've managed through periods of rapid growth, ambiguity, or significant technical change, and your teams came out stronger
A strong technical foundation: you were a strong engineer before moving into management, and you've maintained technical credibility through hands-on engagement or modern AI tools
You've managed Staff-level ICs and helped senior engineers grow into bigger roles
Experience in domains with real complexity: financial systems, distributed infrastructure, regulated environments, or similarly demanding technical areas
You communicate with clarity and directness in writing, in 1:1s, in rooms with executives, and in rooms with engineers
You drive delivery through your team, not around them. You know how to scope work, set priorities, and create the conditions for engineers to do their best work
Experience using AI tools to stay close to technical work (investigating codebases, assessing feasibility, bringing clarity to asks), or genuine enthusiasm to adopt them

Some of our teams are full-stack (frontend, backend, and mobile); others are backend-focused. We're looking for strong engineering leaders regardless of your specific technical background.

We don't expect every candidate to match every bullet. If you're excited about what we're building and confident you can contribute, we'd love to talk.

Stack

Our backend runs on Go, MySQL, DynamoDB, Temporal, Kafka, Kubernetes, and AWS.

Read more about how we build at Imprint on our engineering blog.

Perks & Benefits

Competitive compensation and equity packages
Leading configured work computers of your choice
Flexible paid time off
Fully covered, high-quality healthcare, including fully covered dependent coverage
Additional health coverage includes access to One Medical and the option to enroll in an FSA
20 weeks of paid parental leave for the primary caregiver and 8 weeks for all new parents
Access to industry-leading technology across all of our business units, stemming from our philosophy that we should invest in resources for our team that foster innovation, optimization, and productivity

Imprint is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Imprint is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Imprint welcomes talented individuals from all backgrounds who want to build the future of payments and rewards. If you are passionate about FinTech and eager to grow, let’s move the world forward, together.

We are seeking a HCM Data & Technology Transformation Director to lead the strategy, governance, architecture, migration, integration, and technical delivery of large-scale Human Capital Management (HCM) modernization programs. This executive-level role serves as the senior advisor and workstream leader responsible for aligning business objectives, data strategy, technology architecture, and program execution to ensure successful implementation and long-term operational success. Executive Leadership & Client Advisory

Lead the HCM Data and Technology workstream, serving as the primary point of accountability for data, architecture, integration, testing, security, and technical readiness.

Develop and execute integrated data and technology strategies aligned to business, operational, and transformation objectives.

Experience integrating enterprise platforms with payroll, finance, identity management, timekeeping, benefits, recruiting, learning, reporting, or other business systems.
Working knowledge of APIs, middleware, ETL, file-based interfaces, and batch and real-time integration patterns.

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Engineering, HRIS, or a related field.
