Demonstrated ability to communicate complex data and technology topics to both executive and technical audiences.
Experience supporting federal HCM, Human Resources Information Technology (HRIT), shared-services, ERP, or enterprise HR modernization programs.
Experience supporting a federal transportation organization or another organization with complex, distributed operations and multiple organizational components.

new_jobs.description:
Why You Should Apply for This Job

At the Client, we are committed to providing an employment package that recognizes excellence, encourages safe production and supports a culture built around strong core values. Here, you’ll find a collaborative environment where safety is a top priority, all opinions are valued, and people are empowered to grow in their careers. Apply Today!

Where You Will Work
The Client’s headquarters is in Phoenix, Arizona. Several hundred employees support operations in finance, human resources, information technology, planning and other functions from the main office, satellite offices or online.

As a Hybrid employee, you’ll engage in virtual collaboration as well as attend in-person meetings at the Client’s Collaboration Hub in Phoenix or at one of its site locations. The Collaboration Hub provides an open, flexible workspace for individuals and teams to come together for various business needs. Amenities at the Hub include a working café, phone booths and meeting rooms with technology tools for virtual and in-person collaboration.

In-person attendance may vary based on the position and department requirements.
Phoenix is the capital of Arizona and enjoys mostly bright skies throughout the year. It is an ideal location for those who enjoy the outdoors, sports, concerts, technology and other big-city amenities. There are excellent neighborhoods throughout the Phoenix area, with easy access to nature, arts, entertainment and more.

What You Will Do
Lead project engineering outcomes across a portfolio of capital projects, providing technical leadership in Process Engineering, Process Automation and Instrumentation disciplines. Oversee the delivery lifecycle from concept and design through commissioning and operational ramp-up, ensuring projects achieve performance targets and reach nameplate capacity.

Coordinate and align cross-functional teams, strategically deploy technical talent to maximize project execution success, and foster collaboration across operations, project delivery teams and external engineering partners. Drive engineering consistency, innovation and continuous improvement while ensuring safe, reliable and efficient project delivery.
Develop and execute enterprise-wide Process Engineering, Automation and Instrumentation strategies that support business objectives and operational excellence.
Prioritize project portfolio investments and strategically allocate engineering resources based on project risk, complexity and stage of development.
Lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, collaboration and timely decision-making.
Provide oversight of process design activities, including flowsheets, mass and energy balances, while driving improvements in plant performance, recovery, throughput and efficiency.
Lead Process Safety Management (PSM) programs and hazard assessment activities throughout engineering, construction, commissioning, start-up and operational phases.
Establish continuous improvement processes that leverage operational feedback to optimize designs, enhance reliability and prevent recurring issues.
Develop and standardize instrumentation strategies, ensuring effective specification, implementation, commissioning, start-up and operational readiness across projects.
Define process control philosophies, oversee integration of DCS, PLC and SCADA systems, and champion advanced digital technologies, including APC and predictive analytics, through strong IT/OT partnerships.
Provide technical leadership across the full project lifecycle, ensuring compliance with engineering standards and regulatory requirements while achieving safety, cost, schedule and performance objectives.
Perform other duties as required.

What You Bring to the Client
Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline and fifteen (15) years of experience in process engineering, controls or automation within industrial environments such as mining, metals, oil & gas or chemical processing.
Five (5) years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
Demonstrated experience supporting capital project delivery within relevant technical functions.
Strong leadership and organizational skills with the ability to influence across functions.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving abilities.
Ability to build and lead cross-functional teams where engineers report by process area rather than discipline.
Experience scaling engineering teams across multiple concurrent mega-projects.
Ability to operate effectively within a complex, matrixed organization.
Commitment to safety, continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Preferred Qualifications
Master’s degree in Engineering or a related field.
Deep expertise in process control systems, including DCS, PLC and SCADA, and instrumentation design.
Experience with advanced process control, optimization and digital transformation initiatives.
Strong knowledge of process safety and risk management practices.
Experience working with EPC/EPCM contractors on large-scale projects.

new_jobs.title: Head of Embedded Software
new_jobs.description:
Head of Embedded Software

Burlingame, California
Full-time
Reports to CTO  
About the Company

Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven sodium-ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid.  
Sodium-ion is cheap, readily available, and safe — making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market.  
Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners including TDK Ventures, Eclipse Ventures, and GM Ventures.  
We are a team of engineers, operators, entrepreneurs, and partners driven by a shared ambition to set the new performance standard for renewable energy and grid resilience.  
About the Role

Peak Energy is looking for a Head of Embedded Software to lead the team building the firmware that runs our gigawatt-scale sodium-ion energy storage systems. This is a hands-on leadership role — you'll manage a team of ~6 embedded and firmware engineers while continuing to contribute directly to critical firmware architecture, safety-critical code paths, and hardware bring-up.  
This is a player-coach role by design. Strong embedded engineering ability is the most important qualification — you need to be someone your team learns from technically, not just someone who runs their calendar. You'll set the technical direction for our embedded stack, own the firmware roadmap end-to-end, and be the person the CTO turns to when there's a hard technical call to make on the embedded side of the ESS platform.  
You'll also own the team: hiring, coaching, career growth, and building a culture of engineering rigor. As Peak scales toward Q1 2027 production at our Sacramento factory, the embedded team's output is directly on the critical path — this is a role with real stakes and real ownership.  
We're open on title and level based on candidate strengths — this role can flex from Principal Embedded Engineer + Team Lead through Director, depending on who we meet. Strong embedded engineering skills are non-negotiable; leadership scope will flex to fit.  
What You'll Do — Technical (Player)

Set the technical direction and architecture for Peak's embedded software stack across the ESS platform.  

Contribute hands-on to critical firmware code — real-time C++ RTOS-based systems targeting microcontrollers, safety-critical BMS logic, and supervisory control.  

Own the toughest technical calls: architectural choices, safety-case design, RTOS selection, hardware interface design, real-time performance.  

Lead code reviews on high-risk paths; set the coding standards, review process, and development practices the team operates under.  

Drive hardware bring-up, system integration, validation, and field-support engineering alongside your team.  

Represent embedded software in cross-functional forums with electrical, systems, controls, and hardware teams. Push back where the design won't work; propose better alternatives.  

Stay in the code enough that your team respects your judgment. Rough target: ~30–50% IC time.  

What You'll Do — Leadership (Coach)

Manage a team of ~6 embedded and firmware engineers, including Senior Staff and Staff-level ICs. Own hiring, onboarding, performance, and career growth.  

Set the team's roadmap and delivery cadence. Break the work down, sequence it, and track it — including the tough tradeoffs when priorities shift.  

Build the operating rhythm: standups, sprint planning, retros, on-call rotation, technical decision reviews.  

Grow the team by ~2–3 more hires over the next 12 months. Own the hiring bar and the intake process.  

Coach individual engineers on career growth, tough feedback conversations, and the day-to-day work of getting better.  

Represent the team's work and its constraints to engineering leadership, product, and cross-functional stakeholders.  

Live Peak's values in how you lead — speed through focus, mission over self, face the brutal truth, be a good person.  

What You'll Bring — Required

10-15+ years of professional embedded software engineering experience with a strong track record of hands-on technical contribution to shipping hardware products.  

Deep expertise in real-time embedded firmware — C++, RTOS-based systems, safety-critical or high-reliability applications.  

Experience shipping at least two commercial or industrial hardware products from prototype through production.  

Proven ability to design and evolve embedded software architecture for complex, safety-critical systems (BMS, motor control, automotive, aerospace, medical, or similar).  

2+ years of prior people management experience — direct reports, performance conversations, hiring decisions.  

Strong debugging skills using debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related test equipment. You know how to find the bug when the stack trace isn't enough.  

Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.  

Eligible to work in the United States.  

What You'll Bring — Preferred

Experience in energy storage, battery management systems, EVs, or other high-reliability, safety-critical hardware products.  

Familiarity with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, UL 991, or similar).  

Prior experience building an embedded team from small (<5) to mid-scale (10–20) — hiring, onboarding, technical bar-setting.  

Experience with hardware bring-up, validation, and manufacturing test infrastructure.  

Comfort with Linux as a development environment, CMake/Make, Git, GitHub, Docker/Earthly, and modern CI tooling.  

Track record of representing engineering to executive leadership — presenting to CTOs, boards, or customer technical teams.  

Peak Energy Core Values

Speed Through Focus — Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality.  

Mission Over Self — It's about the greater good; confident humility. Take ownership and accountability.  

Face the Brutal Truth — Transparency, honesty, big-picture curiosity. Fearless decision making.  

Be a Good Person — Kindness, collaboration, and teamwork.  

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $235,000 – $300,000, with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes flexible time off, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a strong 401(k) plan, meaningful equity, and many other perks. Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector.  
Equal Opportunity

Peak Energy is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage women, people of color, and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. We value skills, potential, and perspective over specific credentials. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't look perfect on paper, we still want to hear from you.  
At Peak Energy Technologies Inc., we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us a more capable, innovative, and competitive company. We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Peak Energy Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Responsible for asset and inventory management

new_jobs.description:
Description

BOS35 is one of two major innovation hubs within Amazon Robotics’ RDPI Global Engineering organization — alongside ANR10 in Hamme, Belgium — responsible for developing the packaging, sortation, and labeling automation programs that serve Amazon’s global fulfillment network. The BOS35 Site Leader owns all engineering, assembly, testing, and R&D functions that reside at BOS35, with safety as the foundational principle in both product design and daily site operations. This leader will take the site from its current state to a mature, 100+ person organization that champions the design, build, and preparation to scale for the AR RDPI portfolio.

This is not a traditional engineering management role. The BOS35 Site Leader is the single-threaded owner of site-level outcomes — responsible for the physical environment where ideas become validated hardware. The role integrates three organizational pillars (Solutions, Products, and Manufacturing & Operations), manages the lab and prototype manufacturing floor, ensures operational readiness for multi-program execution, and builds the culture and talent pipeline that sustains Amazon’s in-house automation capability. Safety runs through every dimension of this role: the products we design must be safe for the associates and RME technicians who operate and maintain them, and the facility where we develop those products must be a model for safe lab and workshop operations.

The leader you place in this role will shape how Amazon develops and scales its next generation of automation. You will work at the intersection of hardware innovation, manufacturing readiness, and operational excellence — ensuring that the programs born at BOS35 are not just technically sound, but safe, scalable, and ready to deploy across the global network.

Key job responsibilities

Own BOS35 as a site. Serve as the primary operational and technical leader for the BOS35 facility. Manage lab infrastructure, space allocation, equipment, and site-level priorities. Own the site safety culture — ensuring that lab operations, workshop activities, prototype builds, and equipment use meet or exceed Amazon’s EHS standards. Maintain a zero-recordable mindset across all BOS35 operations. Ensure the physical environment enables multi-program R&D, prototyping, and early-stage manufacturing in parallel while protecting every person who enters the facility.
Champion safety as a leadership principle. Safety at BOS35 operates on two axes. First, the products we design must be safe for the associates and RME technicians who operate and maintain them in the field — requiring safety risk assessments, hazard analyses, and regulatory compliance embedded from concept phase. Second, the facility where we develop those products must be a model for safe lab and workshop operations — from CNC machining and assembly to high-voltage testing and robot commissioning. Own the site’s safety record, drive proactive hazard identification, lead incident investigations to root cause, and build safety into every operating procedure. Collaborate with Engineering Safety and EHS to ensure regulatory compliance and continuous improvement.
Build and lead a 100+ person organization. Recruit, develop, and retain a world-class team of mechanical, electrical, controls, and test engineers; assembly captains and technicians; TPMs; and lab operations staff. Build a leadership bench that scales with the organization.
Drive operational cadence. Establish and maintain site-level mechanisms (daily standups, weekly flash reports, monthly business reviews) that provide visibility into program health, resource utilization, lab throughput, safety metrics, and escalation paths.

A day in the life

Bridge innovation to production. Ensure that hardware developed at BOS35 transitions smoothly to scaled manufacturing — whether at contract manufacturers (Jabil, ATS) or through the MTO technology transfer process. Own DFM, DVT, and production qualification readiness at the site level.
Lead assembly and prototype operations. Manage the BOS35 assembly floor, including Assembly Captains, build technicians, and lab equipment. Drive lean manufacturing principles, build quality, and throughput for Alpha and pre-Beta hardware. Enforce safe work practices on the assembly floor — including lockout/tagout procedures, machine guarding, PPE compliance, and ergonomic standards — ensuring that prototype and early-production operations do not compromise associate safety even under schedule pressure.
Partner with MTO and AME. Collaborate with the centrally-reporting Manufacturing Technical Operations and Advanced Manufacturing Engineering teams to ensure BOS35 builds inform and accelerate CM technology transfer.
Shape the innovation hub identity. BOS35, alongside ANR10, defines Amazon’s in-house automation development capability. Build a culture of safety, urgency, craftsmanship, and customer obsession that attracts top engineering talent and retains institutional knowledge.
Drive AI-enabled efficiency. Champion adoption of AI tools across the engineering lifecycle — from AI-assisted code generation in controls to GenAI documentation and simulation-based validation — to multiply the impact of the team without linear HC growth.
Represent BOS35 to senior leadership. Serve as the voice of BOS35 in leadership reviews, MBRs, OP1/OP2 planning, and cross-functional forums. Provide data-driven recommendations on investment priorities, capacity planning, and organizational design.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
5+ years of engineering team management experience
10+ years of manufacturing, process, industrial engineering experience
Demonstrated experience building and scaling a hardware development or R&D site from early stage to mature operations
Track record of delivering complex electromechanical systems from concept through production qualification with a demonstrated commitment to both product safety and operational safety in lab/manufacturing environments

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related field
Experience in technical leadership of development, testing, and implementation of large-scale, complex technology projects
Experience leading a multi-disciplinary site (engineering + manufacturing + lab operations) with full P&L or budget ownership
Background in industrial automation, robotics, or mechatronics product development
Experience managing technology transfer to contract manufacturers, including PPAP, DFM/DFA, and production qualification processes
Familiarity with safety certification processes (NRTL, CE marking, risk assessments per ISO 12100/ISO 13849) and industrial safety standards (OSHA, ANSI/RIA)
Experience operating in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where the organizational model is being built alongside the products
Strong executive communication skills — ability to simplify complex technical tradeoffs for VP-level and above audiences
Experience leveraging AI/ML tools to drive engineering productivity and operational efficiency

Engineering moves at software speed. Manufacturing doesn’t. Yet.

Machina Labs is changing that. We build intelligent, software-defined factories that produce complex metal structures directly from digital design. By integrating advanced metal forming, robotics, and automated production inside a flexible factory architecture, we enable customers to move from prototype to production in weeks, not years.

Backed by Lockheed Martin, Toyota, and NVIDIA, we’re building the manufacturing infrastructure that defense, aerospace, and advanced mobility programs will run on.

If you want to work on hard problems that matter and see them fly, drive, and defend, this is the place.

About The Role

Machina Labs is looking for a Director of Infrastructure & Security to build the secure, scalable technology foundation for our next stage of growth.

You’ll lead enterprise IT, cloud and DevOps infrastructure, cybersecurity, compliance, and physical security systems across Machina Labs’ commercial operations and Machina Bellator, our defense-focused subsidiary.

This is a build role. You’ll inherit capable teams and an existing technology foundation, but there is significant work ahead as Machina scales. You will define the infrastructure and security roadmap, strengthen our defense-compliant environment, build our Security Engineering capability, and ensure our systems can scale without slowing down the engineers and operators who rely on them.

You’ll report to the VP of Engineering – Software & IT and partner closely with leaders across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, EHS, Legal, and the broader business.

This is a player-coach role for someone who can set strategy and build organizations while staying close enough to the technology to dive in when it matters.

What You’ll Do

Set the infrastructure and security strategy. Define and execute the strategy for IT, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and security systems across Machina Labs and Machina Bellator as our teams, facilities, and defense programs scale.
Lead and grow the organization. Lead the IT and DevOps teams, define the organization needed for the next stage of growth, develop existing leaders, and build the Security Engineering function from the ground up.
Scale cloud and DevOps infrastructure. Guide the architecture, reliability, security, and cost management of our AWS environment in partnership with DevOps and Software Engineering. Establish scalable approaches to infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, and production operations.
Build our cybersecurity capability. Establish and mature security operations across endpoint protection, SIEM and logging, threat detection and response, vulnerability management, incident response, and security architecture.

Own physical security technology. Partner with EHS, which owns the broader physical security program, to architect and operate the technology behind facility security — including access control, surveillance, identity integration, monitoring, and related security systems.
Establish policy and governance. Partner with Legal, EHS, Compliance, Engineering, and Operations to create pragmatic security and IT policies that protect the company and satisfy customer and regulatory requirements without creating unnecessary friction.

10+ years of experience across infrastructure, enterprise IT, cybersecurity, DevOps, or related technical functions, including significant experience leading technical teams and senior leaders.
Experience owning infrastructure and/or security in a complex engineering, manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or similarly regulated environment.
Demonstrated ability to build and scale technology functions, operating models, and teams — not simply operate established systems.
Strong working knowledge of modern enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, networking, identity and access management, and cybersecurity architecture.
Experience with AWS or comparable cloud environments and modern DevOps practices.
Experience building or operating cybersecurity programs spanning areas such as endpoint security, logging/SIEM, vulnerability management, incident response, and detection and response.
Experience working with security and compliance frameworks such as CMMC or comparable regulated environments.

Have a seat at our table. With opportunities across locations and functions, a culture grounded in our Core Four values - gratitude, communication, respect and accountability - and a strong commitment to learning, collaboration, and innovation, Smithfield offers challenging and rewarding careers where you can grow, contribute and make a real impact. The Value You’ll Bring

The position summary states the general nature and purpose of the job. Overall accountabilities are defined in this section.

As a Senior Regional Engineering Manager, you’ll lead the development of game-changing operational strategies and drive excellence across multiple locations. You’ll provide expert technical guidance, optimize M&E processes, and tackle key challenges to elevate plant performance. By closing skill gaps, and fostering strong cross-functional relationships, you’ll empower your team to succeed.

With your extensive expertise in fresh and packaged meat manufacturing equipment and maintenance & engineering processes, you’ll be a driving force in sustaining high-performance operations. You’ll influence key decisions, lead lower-level engineers, collaborate seamlessly with peers, and ensure plant management is equipped with the right technical insights to maintain peak operational success. Your strategic vision and leadership will be the catalyst for transforming the M&E landscape and driving consistent improvement.

What You’ll Do

The below statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. May perform other duties as assigned.

Leadership & Performance Management You'll lead engineering team members to cover multiple plants to ensure optimal plant performance, overseeing Project Engineering teams and projects at all locations. Manage direct reports from diverse engineering disciplines (e.g., Reliability, Strategic, Automation and /or Project Engineering) to maintain excellence. Ensure priority projects and capital/expense plans are effectively managed and properly resourced. Guide and participate in equipment comparison tests, FAT’s/SAT’s, master plans, and research of new equipment opportunities. Oversee the effective execution of plant utilities and process discipline by collaborating with the Infrastructure Group.
Strategic Oversight & Continuous Improvement Manage an Annual Capital Budget of up to $50mm, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and resource optimization. Partner with Plant Operations and Maintenance leadership to identify opportunities and implement strategies that boost operational performance. Lead the evaluation and identification of M&E process gaps across multiple plants, driving continuous improvement initiatives. Develop and maintain a culture of improvement within M&E departments, focusing on cost savings and process optimization. Lead the refinement and enhancement of the Engineering Excellence assessment process to ensure continuous evolution and relevance.
Technical & Operational Excellence You'll also provide technical leadership, overseeing the development and implementation of production technologies and technical improvements. Ensure plant teams have the expertise and troubleshooting capabilities to effectively handle major outages and complex equipment issues. Drive clarity in engineering standards and resource scheduling, aligning performance with established processes. Develop and implement programs, policies, and practices to ensure safe, high-quality food production that meets regulatory and company standards.
Compliance & Risk Management You will ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Local engineering codes and regulations by keeping M&E programs, policies, and procedures up-to-date. Lead and execute cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and transfer knowledge across the organization, maintaining high standards for Quality, Food Safety, and Safety Systems.
Employee Development & Team Leadership Lead, inspire, and develop high-performing engineering teams, providing clear direction to achieve business objectives and innovative solutions. Partner with HR to deploy leadership development opportunities, drive performance management, and build a diverse, engaged workforce. Foster a culture focused on workplace safety, open communication, empowerment, and employee recognition.

What We’re Seeking

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Engineering or related field and 8+ years of relevant experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.
2+ years of demonstrated experience in team management/development or project leadership is required.
Ability to apply sound engineering principles to operational and design issues.
Must possess Project Management skills; Contract Administration skills; National codes and standards interpretation skills.
Proficient in engineering economics.
Proficient in AutoCAD.
Proficient in Microsoft Office suite.
Energized by collaboration through travel to other locations. (50% of the time).

Other Skills That Make You Stand Out

Knowledge of engineering principles and techniques related to food processing and the meat industry.
Previous experience in the management of multi-million dollar projects with large scopes.
Ability to work well with others in fast paced, dynamic environment.
Ability to be respectful, approachable and team oriented while building strong working relationships and a positive work environment.
Excellent written and oral communication skills, organizational planning, teamwork, analytical reasoning, and adaptability.

Supervisory Responsibilities

Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of their team.
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws.
Responsibilities include supporting the interviewing and hiring of skilled trade employees and the training of these employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; addressing complaints and resolving problems.

The expected pay range for this position is $120,000 - $162,500 annually.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Data Engineering
new_jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values

We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.
We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.
We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.
We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position

The Senior Manager, Data Engineering will manage an engineering team responsible for building and operating Veracyte’s enterprise data platforms. This role combines people leadership with direct technical ownership and is suited for someone who can move comfortably between architecture, implementation details, production operations, and team development.

You will guide the evolution of modern data lake and lakehouse environments, delivering trusted and actionable data to scientific, clinical, operational, and commercial teams. You will partner closely with data science, analytics, product, clinical, software engineering, Security, and IT to translate business and scientific needs into secure, scalable, and maintainable solutions.

This position is based in our San Diego office with a hybrid working model or may be US remote.

Manage and develop a team of data engineers, supporting talent planning, hiring, coaching, performance management, career development, and team effectiveness.
Remain close enough to the technical work to guide architecture, design reviews, code quality, troubleshooting, and key implementation decisions.
Collaborate with business and scientific stakeholders to translate requirements into platform capabilities, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
Help establish and maintain data platform standards, governance practices, architectural guidelines, and operational processes.
Make pragmatic architectural decisions using AWS services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch, and related technologies such as Snowflake.
Support continuous improvement of engineering practices for CI/CD, automated testing, observability, lineage, documentation, security, privacy, and code quality.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Analytics, Data Science, Product, Clinical, Laboratory, Software Engineering, Security, and IT, to support shared goals and initiatives.
Ensure data-platform security, regulatory compliance, privacy, and quality-management requirements are addressed through appropriate architecture, controls, tooling, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration.
Drive platform delivery and operational excellence, helping ensure solutions meet business needs, performance expectations, and production reliability requirements.
Balance delivery priorities, operational support, platform enhancements, technical debt reduction, vendor relationships, and resource considerations.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend adoption based on measurable improvements in maintainability, scalability, reliability, performance, security, and cost.
Communicate technical decisions, alternatives, risks, recommendations, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and leaders across multiple functions, and build shared understanding in complex or sensitive situations.
Model collaborative, inclusive leadership by engaging the right stakeholders early, seeking diverse perspectives, committing to decisions, pursuing better solutions, and maintaining high standards for quality and responsible use of company resources.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
8+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, software engineering, data platforms, or related fields.
5+ years of people-management experience, including responsibility for team objectives, work planning, performance management, development, and staffing decisions.
Demonstrated experience leading a data engineering department or multiple related disciplines and delivering outcomes that affect broader functional or business priorities.
Demonstrated experience designing, building, and operating production data pipelines and data platforms, including data lake or lakehouse architectures.
Strong working knowledge of AWS services such as S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, IAM, and CloudWatch, or comparable technologies.
Hands-on proficiency with SQL and Python, with the ability to review code, evaluate technical designs, troubleshoot production problems, and guide implementation decisions.
Experience with ETL/ELT frameworks, orchestration tools, distributed data processing, analytical data modeling, and reusable data products or shared platform capabilities.
Practical experience implementing data quality, automated testing, observability, lineage, security, privacy, and regulatory controls.
Experience establishing operational objectives, policies, procedures, work plans, schedules, and resource priorities for a technical team.
Experience managing technical debt and operational risk while continuing to deliver business and product priorities.
Proven ability to collaborate across engineering, scientific, product, clinical, business, Security, and IT teams, including the ability to influence and build alignment in complex situations.
Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, alternatives, risks, and trade-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in biotechnology, life sciences, diagnostics, healthcare, or another regulated data environment.
Experience working in environments subject to medical device regulations and quality-management requirements.
Experience working with scientific, clinical, laboratory, LIMS, or bioinformatics data.
Familiarity with ML/AI data workflows and supporting MLOps platforms.
Experience optimizing AWS data-platform cost, reliability, security, and performance.
Experience developing reusable data products, shared platform capabilities, or domain-oriented data architectures.
Knowledge of metadata management, data catalogs, and lineage platforms.
Experience managing budget inputs, vendors, or resource planning for a data engineering or platform team.
Experience helping a team scale its processes without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.

We know that great candidates may not meet every qualification listed. If this role excites you and you believe your experience can help us advance our mission, we encourage you to apply.

For candidates based in our San Diego office
, the range is $199,000- $220,000.

For candidates based in our South San Francisco office
, the range is $202,000- $258,000.

For candidates that are Remote
: $192,825 - $220,000

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$199,000—$220,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter).

new_jobs.title: Sr. Manager, AMER LAN Engineering Lead
new_jobs.description:
Role Summary

All over the world, Pfizer colleagues work together to positively impact health for everyone, everywhere. Our colleagues have the opportunity to grow and develop a career that offers both individual and company success; be part of an ownership culture that values diversity and where all colleagues are energized and engaged and have the ability to impact health and lives of millions of people. Digital is at the core of how Pfizer delivers Breakthroughs that Change Patient’s Lives. Advanced technologies that accelerate research, development, manufacturing, and patient access to therapies are all made possible by the infrastructures that enable our Digital landscape.

The CISO, Infrastructure and Cloud Services organization delivers excellence in the pursuit of those breakthroughs through industry-leading infrastructure operations performance. We strive to revolutionize service dependability by applying advanced analytics to drive predictive detection and interventions. We place data at the heart of what we do and apply a relentless focus on continuous improvement to enable Pfizer’s business processes and patient outcomes.

The Sr. Manager, AMER LAN Engineering Lead designs, deploys, and maintains complex enterprise network infrastructures. They lead technical projects, mentor engineering staff, and manage network availability, security, and performance. This hands-on role requires high-level IT architecture with daily network engineering and operations tasks, along with team management of both Colleagues and Contractors.

The role blends people leadership with deep technical ownership: leading a team of engineers and contractors while personally driving architecture decisions, automation practices, and regional investment priorities.

As the AMER lead, this person partners closely with counterparts in EMEA and APAC to develop standardized, globally scalable network solutions, and serves as the global owner of IP address management (IPAM) allocations across the entire enterprise network. Success in this role means a resilient, secure, and automated regional network that aligns to a consistent global standard.

Role Responsibilities

People & Team Leadership

Manage the team - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of LAN engineers (Colleagues and contractors) across the Americas region.
Own People eXperience (PX) & administrative processes - Responsible for all PX and administrative documentation, including onboarding, timekeeping, contractor agreements, and record-keeping.
Drive performance - Conduct performance reviews, set goals and development plans, provide ongoing coaching, and manage staffing and resourcing decisions.
Manage Projects - Oversee project scopes, deliverables, and performance, ensuring alignment with regional and global standards.

Architecture, Design & Investment

Lead architecture and design - Own and facilitate architecture and design discussions for LAN and wireless infrastructure across the region.
Drive decisions - Translate design discussions into concrete decisions on hardware purchases, technology selection, and regional projects.
Own the roadmap - Define and prioritize the network roadmap, balancing lifecycle, capacity, security, and cost.
Manage projects & budget - Lead regional network projects end to end and provide input into budgeting and capital planning.

Automation, IaC & CI/CD

Automate the network - Champion network automation using Python, Ansible, GitHub, and other Automation Tools to reduce manual effort and configuration drift.
Practice Infrastructure as Code - Manage network configuration and infrastructure as code, using GitHub for version control, review, and collaboration.
Build CI/CD workflows - Establish a network design that allows for the creation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines for network changes, including automated validation and testing.

Global IPAM Ownership

Own global IPAM allocation process - Serve as the global lead for IP address management (IPAM) allocations across the entire enterprise network.
Govern the address space - Define allocation standards, maintain accuracy of records, and coordinate IP planning across all regions.

Global Collaboration & Scale

Partner across regions - Workwith peers in EMEA and APAC to design solutions that scale consistently across a global, multinational enterprise.
Standardize globally - Contribute to global network standards, reference architectures, and best practices, ensuring regional alignment.
Represent AMER - Act as the regional point of accountability in global network governance and planning forums.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required in a technical field such as Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering
6+ years of experience in a Sr. Network Engineering role
Design, manage, and troubleshoot complex large-scale networks.
IPv4/IPv6 subnetting, administration and planning
Expert level Industry certifications (CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent expertise)
A strong team player with excellent oral and written communication skills
Process oriented with great documentation skills.
Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving and troubleshooting ability.
Self-starter with the ability to independently prioritize and complete multiple tasks with little to no supervision.
Strong knowledge of LAN and WLAN technologies
Experience managing vendor relationships and technology procurement at scale.
Proven experience leading a team of engineers and/or contractors, including performance management and HR/administrative responsibilities.
Demonstrated experience in an agile work environment possessing qualities such as a collaborative mindset, adaptability to change, and a proactive problem-solving approach.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree major in a technical field such as Information Technology or Computer Science/Engineering
Strong proficiency in Python and Ansible for network automation.
Experience managing a financial budget.
Experience operating in a large, regulated enterprise environment (biopharma, life sciences, or similarly regulated industry a plus).
Professional level Industry certifications (CCNP, CCSE, CISSP, or equivalent expertise)
Experience with design/implementation/troubleshooting Cisco/Meraki/Aruba Wireless technologies, Cisco Identity Service Engine, Cisco Catalyst Center, Ekahau App Suite
Experience with security access architectures (ISE/SGT, Adaptive Policy, Zero-Trust Network Access)
Knowledge of best practices and IT operations in an always-up, always-available service
ITSM Tools - Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Physical/Mental Requirements

Not Applicable

Non-standard Work Schedule, Travel Or Environment Requirements

Standard work schedule with limited international travel (e.g., 1 trip per year to the United States).

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $139,100.00 to $231,900.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 17.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Technical Applications Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Job Title:
Senior Manager, Technical Application Engineering

Location:
Lockport, LA

Job Summary:
The Senior Manager of Technical Application Engineering leads the Bollinger organization’s technical supplier integration function, serving as the primary interface between Engineering, Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, and external suppliers. This role is responsible for ensuring supplier technical information is complete, accurate, and effectively integrated into the company’s products and engineering documentation throughout the product lifecycle.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, Native Data
new_jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

Your role and mission

Data is at the core of Apollo's product.

Our People and Company datasets, and the enrichment fields that make them useful, power nearly every part of the Apollo platform. We believe we already have one of the best B2B datasets in the world. Your mission is to make it the best.

You will own the engineering organization responsible for Apollo's core data platform: how we acquire data, enrich it, understand its quality and freshness, move it across systems, and continuously improve it using the signals generated by millions of Apollo users.

This is one of the highest-leverage engineering leadership roles at Apollo. You will own three critical areas: Native Data, Waterfall Enrichment, and Scraping & Extension, and grow the organization as the platform expands. It’s an incredibly complex problem that involves not only identifying the right datasets and leveraging the information we get from indexing people and company data from across the internet, but also applying the logic that makes sure we always have the right information for every company and user. Also, in data, latency matters – the more fresh the data, the more valuable it is in triggering outreach. As a leader on the team, you will have to deal with significant ambiguity (e.g., what sources should we prioritize and why? How should we think about event data versus relational?) and work relentlessly to make sure our data coverage and quality are always best-in-class.

Data is the lifeblood that makes the execution and intelligence within Apollo work.

What You Will Do

Own the engineering strategy and execution for Apollo's core data platform (partnering with Ray Li, Apollo’s CTO and co-founder)
Lead and grow the teams responsible for Data. Build and develop a world-class engineering team with multiple Principal Engineers across multiple geographies
Scale the Native Data team from current headcount to the right size to solve the problems described above
Build systems that leverage signals from Apollo's active users, data network, browser extension, web data, customer CRMs, and other sources to continuously improve our dataset
Develop a deep understanding of the coverage, quality, confidence, and freshness of every major data vector
Build systems for identifying when Apollo's data is stale or out of sync and determining when and how it should be refreshed. Work with Sales to understand when we win/lose customers based on our quality. Work on Vendor selection and diversification.
Create feedback loops across the GTM platform so signals like bounced emails, stale phone numbers, and customer corrections continuously improve Apollo's underlying data
Own the systems that ingest and distribute data across Apollo's broader platform
Lead the architecture behind large-scale enrichment, scraping, ETL, reverse ETL, and data synchronization
Own the monitoring, dashboards, and quality benchmarks that make data freshness and accuracy measurable at scale.
Join Apollo’s Executive Staff as a key decision-maker and partner with the broader engineering, product, data, and cross-functional teams as a subject matter expert on the long-term strategy for Apollo's most important asset

How we work: AI-native by default

Apollo is an AI-native engineering organization.

You will set the standard for how your teams use AI and agents to move faster across design, implementation, investigation, and operations. More importantly, you will identify where AI can fundamentally change how Apollo acquires, validates, enriches, reconciles, and maintains data at scale. We are looking for leaders who see AI not simply as a productivity tool, but as a new capability for building systems that weren't previously possible.

What We Are Looking For

A track record of leading high-performing engineering teams responsible for large-scale data or distributed systems
Deep technical understanding of data infrastructure, distributed systems, databases, ingestion, synchronization, and data quality
Experience operating systems where correctness, freshness, reliability, scale, and cost all matter
Experience building and growing engineering teams while maintaining a high technical bar
The ability to move comfortably between organizational leadership, product strategy, and deep technical discussions
Strong judgment around when to build, buy, integrate, or redesign critical infrastructure
The ability to lead through ambiguity and turn complex technical problems into clear direction for multiple teams
A record of attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional engineers and engineering leaders
Genuine, current fluency with AI-assisted development and a clear point of view on how AI changes both engineering and large-scale data systems

, and learn voraciously

We’re seeking engineers who are energized by working on cutting-edge ASIC design and distributed software systems, and who are motivated to push the boundaries on how AI can transform everything from chip architecture to system performance at scale.

Cornelis Networks delivers the world’s highest performance scale-out networking solutions for AI and HPC datacenters. Our differentiated architecture seamlessly integrates hardware, software and system level technologies to maximize the efficiency of GPU, CPU and accelerator-based compute clusters at any scale. Our solutions drive breakthroughs in AI & HPC workloads, empowering our customers to push the boundaries of innovation. Backed by top-tier venture capital and strategic investors, we are committed to innovation, performance and scalability - solving the world’s most demanding computational challenges with our next-generation networking solutions.

We are a fast-growing, forward-thinking team of architects, engineers, and business professionals with a proven track record of building successful products and companies. As a global organization, our team spans multiple U.S. states and six countries, and we continue to expand with exceptional talent in onsite, hybrid, and fully remote roles.

Cornelis Networks is looking for a Senior ASIC Design Engineering Manager to lead and grow our RTL design engineering team. Reporting to the VP of ASIC Engineering, with direct exposure to executive leadership, this leader will manage a team of talented design engineers and drive full-lifecycle development of Cornelis’ next-generation, high-performance networking ASICs. The role is accountable for building and driving RTL implementation schedules across all SoC subsystems and full-chip milestones. Success requires deep hands-on expertise in advanced RTL design implementation, methodologies, and SoC flows, from microarchitecture definition through RTL delivery, tape-out readiness, and cross-functional execution with Architecture, Design Verification, Emulation, and Physical Design. This leader will also own headcount planning, hiring, and organizational strategy to build a nimble, efficient, world-class design team. Exposure to AI-based design flows and methodology is preferred.

This role is intended for a senior engineering leader who can combine hands-on ASIC RTL design expertise with disciplined program execution, cross-functional coordination, and team building at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Own ASIC RTL delivery schedules across major milestones by tracking, monitoring, and reporting progress against committed plans.
Utilize data-driven insights to predict schedule risks and proactively reallocate human resources to keep the project on track.
Align RTL delivery schedules with DV and emulation enablement and manage feedback loops and dependencies efficiently.
Facilitate physical design handoffs by ensuring design teams provide high-quality RTL and constraints that minimize timing-closure iterations. Track physical design feedback and delivery schedules to support physical design signoff and tape-out milestones.
Lead long-term headcount planning and organizational design for the ASIC department. Identify skill gaps and execute global talent acquisition strategies that support the product roadmap.

Minimum Qualifications

15+ years in the semiconductor industry, preferably in high performance designs on advanced technology nodes, with at least 5 years in people management
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
Deep understanding of the interaction between Design, Verification, Emulation, and Physical Design teams. You must know "how the work gets done" to manage the people doing it.
Proven ability to lead large engineering organizations through multiple full-cycle ASIC product launches in a remote environment. Ability to coordinate across multiple projects, manage risks and escalations, and work under tight schedules and budget constraints.
Strong technical expertise in microarchitecture development, RTL coding (Verilog/System Verilog), synthesis, STA/timing closure, physical design, and verification methodologies.
Exposure to one or more industry standards/protocol stacks such as PCIe, Ethernet, UCIe, UALink.
Demonstrated ability to optimize designs for PPA (power, performance, area) and to integrate major subsystems (interconnect, I/O, memory).

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to AI based design implementation and verification flows, scripting for automation, milestone tracking and flow integration
Experience building globally distributed ASIC design teams and scaling engineering practices in a remote environment.

Protiviti is looking for a Technology Consulting Senior Manager to join our growing Infrastructure, Cloud, & Security Engineering team.

What You Can Expect

As a Senior Manager, you’ll partner with our clients to identify and manage risk. You'll develop strategies to solve complex business problems using new ways of thinking, and devise solutions to support your clients' needs through using the latest tools and methods.  You’ll develop lasting relationships with client personnel and further these relationships through quality product delivery.  You’ll foster a network within the business community and serve as an ambassador of Protiviti in the market. You will also be a mentor and provide performance development to teams as you oversee the successful completion of project work plans.

What Will Help You Be Successful

You enjoy working across infrastructure, networking, and cloud platforms to design, build, migrate, and/or secure systems and environments.
You are passionate about building trusted relationships with C-level executives and providing exceptional experiences that translate to additional project work.
You have an inherent interest in project management and team leadership.
You promote a positive team culture that fosters open communication among all engagement team members. 
You create development opportunities for others, including participating in the creation and rollout of training, and ways for your team to improve our clients and communities.
You enjoy discovering prospective project work with current and potential clients through networking, knowledge-building, and client interactions.
You excel at identifying opportunities to integrate product solutions and resources to improve client service capabilities.
You view client challenges as opportunities to add value and can translate that into new project proposals and sales.
You are seen as a valued contributor to thought leadership and encourage knowledge-sharing and collaboration across teams.
You have interest in managing a diverse portfolio of clients across industries.

Do Your Talents Include the Following?

Recent hands-on design, deployment, and/or administration experience in Windows Server and Linux systems administration
Working familiarity with Unix variants and Mac OS; prior administration experience a plus
Working familiarity with Amazon AWS, Microsoft Azure and other IaaS providers preferred
Strong enterprise networking design, deployment, and/or administration experience
Working familiarity with enterprise-class vendors and product lines strongly preferred (e.g. Cisco, Cisco Meraki, HPE/Aruba, Juniper, Extreme, Brocade)
Working familiarity with enterprise-class network security appliance vendors and product lines strongly preferred (e.g. Cisco, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, Fortinet)
Working familiarity with SMB/”prosumer” vendors and product lines a plus (e.g. Ubiquiti/UBNT, SonicWall, Mikrotik) a plus
Working familiarity with load balancers, VPN appliances/concentrators a plus
In depth understanding of current enterprise design patterns and norms for basic networking capabilities/concepts (e.g. TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN segmentation, routing and switching, wireless)
Strong familiarity with SMB and entry-level on premises computing infrastructure technologies
Working familiarity with multiple server hardware vendors and associated management tools/platforms (e.g. Dell, HPE, Cisco, SuperMicro) strongly preferred
Working familiarity with hypervisor platforms (e.g. VMware vSphere/ESXi, Microsoft Hyper-V, Nutanix AHV, or others) strongly preferred
Strong familiarity with enterprise storage
Working familiarity with DAS, SAN, and NAS/filer solutions
Working understanding of contemporary network storage protocols and interconnect methods (e.g. iSCSI, CIFS, FibreChannel, NFS)
Strong familiarity with basic on premises infrastructure management best practices
Rack management
Power and cooling demand management
Physical security
Strong familiarity with scripting for administrative, auditing, and other operational purposes
Prior experience writing PowerShell, Python, BASH/other Linux shell scripts strongly preferred 
Prior experience with typical infrastructure and server/endpoint management toolsets
Performance and capacity management tools
Endpoint management / RMM platforms
Patch and vulnerability management tools
Log and event aggregation technologies (Kafka, SIEMs, Splunk, etc.)
Prior experience with capacity planning, VM/server “right-sizing”, performance analysis
Prior experience and ownership designing server, network, application solutions through deployment phase
Prior experience administrating Office 365 services
Prior experience administrating Microsoft Exchange, Google G Suite/Workspace is a plus
Experience designing, building, or remediating an environment to meet specific regulatory requirements such as PCI-DSS, CMMC, NIST 800-53.
Prior experience translating undocumented systems / applications / operating procedures into usable documentation is absolutely necessary; Ability to update or create visualizations of dependency maps or architecture overviews is a must
Prior experience with integration of IT systems in a post-merger/acquisition environment
Prior experience with application rationalization / dependency mapping exercises
Prior experience designing, implementing, or administrating backup and replication/continuity solutions for server, storage, and application infrastructure
Familiarity with typical project management methods (Agile, Waterfall, etc.)
Prior experience translating business requirements (e.g. compliance controls, vendor / business partner requirements) into technical configurations / solutions
Prior experience dealing with third party hardware/software/service vendors preferred
Prior experience translating business continuity / disaster recovery requirements into technical solution designs preferred
Establishing and cultivating business relationships and a professional network, including with senior executives. 
Successfully pursuing business development opportunities and identifying and implementing strategies to obtain new work or clientele.
Ability to translate and communicate issues, risks or challenges to client personnel, including executives. 
Leadership and direct supervisory experience of teams including conducting performance appraisals, mentoring and coaching, oversight and review of work, coordination across teams, and understanding how to motivate.  

Your Educational And Professional Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in (Comp Sci, Comp Eng, Networking) or relevant field, or equivalent experience delivering technology or consulting solutions.
7+ years working in professional services or related fields.
Professional Certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert or similar strongly preferred.
Excellent verbal and written English 
Comfortable collaborating with key business executives, system/application owners or stakeholders in group conversation or direct interview contexts
Ability to rapidly shift between planning / design work and practical execution (“hands on keyboard” tasks for discovery or implementation) is an absolute necessity
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills required
Personal projects / demonstrated extracurricular interest in technology a plus

Our Hybrid Workplace

Protiviti practices a hybrid model, which is a combination of working in person with a purpose and working remotely. This model creates meaningful experiences for our people and our clients while offering a flexible environment. The ratio of remote to in-person requirements vary by client, project, team, and other business factors. Our people work both in-person in local Protiviti offices and on client sites, which can include local or out-of-state travel based on our projects and client requests and commitments.

new_jobs.title: Director of Infrastructure
new_jobs.description:
Focused on employment and labor law since 1958, Jackson Lewis P.C.’s 1,000+ attorneys located in major cities nationwide consistently identify and respond to new ways workplace law intersects business. We help employers develop proactive strategies, strong policies and business-oriented solutions to cultivate high-functioning workforces that are engaged and stable, and share our clients’ goals to emphasize belonging and respect for the contributions of every employee.

The Firm is ranked in the First Tier nationally in the category of Labor and Employment Litigation, as well as in both Employment Law and Labor Law on behalf of Management, in the U.S. News - Best Lawyers® “Best Law Firms”.

Summary

The Director, Infrastructure is a senior technology leader responsible for the strategic planning, design, governance, implementation, security, availability, and continuous improvement of the firm's infrastructure and engineering systems. This role leads firmwide infrastructure strategy and operations across 60+ locations, ensuring secure, resilient, scalable, and cost-effective services that support attorneys, clients, administrative departments, and business operations. The Director partners closely with the CIO and IT leadership to translate firm strategy, client expectations, security requirements, and legal service delivery needs into a practical multi-year technology roadmap.

The Director provides leadership for infrastructure engineering and operations, services, data center and network operations, endpoint and collaboration platforms, service reliability, disaster recovery, vendor performance, managed service provider accountability, and modernization initiatives. The role is expected to maintain high availability and performance for mission-critical legal technology platforms, support secure adoption of cloud and AI-enabled productivity capabilities, and communicate effectively with executive, attorney, business services, technical, and vendor stakeholders. The position requires strong law firm or professional services judgment, strict confidentiality, operational discipline, and the ability to translate legal business needs into practical technology roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute a multi-year infrastructure and cloud services roadmap aligned with the firm’s strategic priorities, risk posture, budget objectives, growth plans, and service expectations.
Lead the design, governance, delivery, and ongoing support of core infrastructure services, including Microsoft cloud platforms, data centers, server and virtualization environments, storage, backup, disaster recovery, network, telephony, endpoint, collaboration, and hybrid connectivity.

Drive modernization of legacy systems and services toward secure, scalable, cloud-enabled, automated, and operationally sustainable platforms while maintaining appropriate controls for legal data, client confidentiality, retention, and compliance.
Oversee Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Intune, Defender, Purview, and related firm-managed cloud services, with accountability for governance, configuration standards, performance, monitoring, cost management, licensing, and adoption planning.
Ensure reliable, secure connectivity across all offices, remote users, and critical firm services through effective oversight of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, firewall, DNS, DHCP, identity, access management, and network segmentation practices.
Establish and maintain infrastructure standards, operating practices, documentation requirements, service health metrics, KPIs, SLAs, and executive reporting that demonstrate platform reliability, user experience, operational risk, and progress against roadmap commitments.
Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning for infrastructure services, including documented runbooks, recovery objectives, testing, remediation tracking, and reporting.
Partner with Information Security, Records, Compliance, Applications, Practice Technology, Knowledge Management, Litigation Support, Training, Office Administration, and Service Desk teams to deliver integrated, reliable, and secure technology services.
Support the technical readiness of new offices, major site expansions, integrations, and significant technology transitions, including connectivity, conference room technology, endpoint infrastructure, printing, telephony, documentation, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization.
Ensure infrastructure and cloud platforms meet applicable cybersecurity specifications, firm policies, client requirements, legal industry expectations, audit needs, cyber insurance requirements, and regulatory obligations related to confidentiality, integrity, availability, and data protection.
Participate in incident, problem, and change management practices, ensuring appropriate testing, communications, approvals, escalation, back-out planning, root-cause analysis, and post-implementation review.
Lead, mentor, and develop internal team members and managed service resources, setting clear priorities, accountability, documentation expectations, service standards, and a culture of customer service, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
Manage strategic vendors, managed service providers, contracts, service levels, renewals, performance reviews, licensing discussions, escalation processes, roadmap alignment, and ongoing accountability for service quality and cost effectiveness.
Develop and manage infrastructure budgets in partnership with IT and Finance leadership, including capital planning, operating spend, forecasting, renewals, cost optimization, and business cases for major investments.
Communicate risks, priorities, progress, service metrics, investment needs, and recommendations clearly to IT leadership, firm leadership, attorneys, business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams.

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive IT experience across infrastructure, cloud, network, enterprise operations, or related technology services, including significant experience leading teams, programs, vendors, or managed services.
5+ years in a leadership role with responsibility for strategic planning, people leadership, service delivery, budgets, vendor management, project execution, and operational accountability.
Experience in a law firm, legal services organization, or professional services environment strongly preferred, with demonstrated appreciation for confidentiality, client service, time-sensitive workflows, and risk-sensitive technology operations.
Demonstrated experience supporting mission-critical business technology environments, including document management, collaboration, secure file sharing, practice management, eDiscovery, records, or related legal business platforms.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud services, Azure/hybrid cloud, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, identity and access management, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Intune, Defender, Purview, Windows Server, virtualization, storage, backup, networking, and data center operations.
Proven ability to develop and execute multi-year roadmaps, enterprise standards, cloud governance models, operational runbooks, disaster recovery plans, and modernization initiatives.
Strong understanding of ITIL/ITSM practices, including incident, problem, change, asset, configuration, service level, and knowledge management.
Ability to prioritize multiple concurrent projects and operational demands across a large multi-office environment while maintaining service quality, documentation, risk visibility, and executive-level communication.
Proven ability to work effectively with executives, attorneys, business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and managed service providers.
Strong judgment, critical thinking, financial discipline, and ability to connect technology decisions to business outcomes, client service, security, risk reduction, and operational resiliency.

For NY Metro, San Francisco Metro and Los Angeles Metro area, the expected salary range for this position is between $216,250,000 and $252,250. This position is also eligible for annual bonuses. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

Jackson Lewis offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance
401(k) Retirement Plan
Flexible Spending & Health Savings Account
firm-paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
Employee assistance program and other benefits

For Illinois, the expected salary range for this position is between $198,250 and $231,250. This position is also eligible for annual bonuses. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance

firm-paid holidays, vacation, and sick time

new_jobs.description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. Since 1841, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at  dnb.com/careers .

Director, ServiceNow Engineering (hands-on) is responsible for leading the overall development activities of the ServiceNow Platform. The leader needs enough technical depth to challenge designs, estimate work, make architecture decisions and develop/configure as needed. Along with leading a team of highly skilled engineers.

The Director, ServiceNow Engineering will work with various ServiceNow Process Owners and Technology Operations teams to understand their needs and propose appropriate architecture/design for implementation. As the leader of the team, this role will work with the team to grow their skills, drive opportunities of platform adoption, and focus on engineering excellence. 

Essential Responsibilities:

Drive Core Engineering Excellence to ensure we build, run and operate the ServiceNow Platform and core products with high Availability, Resiliency and operational insights.

Develop and execute on project plan and timelines, manage budgets with our cloud provides and manage the relationships with internal and external partners.

Collaborate with various stakeholders to understand their needs and propose appropriate architecture/design for implementation.

Identify areas for growth with a focus on software development testing and automation.

Drive automation with AI and other ServiceNow automation features while ensuring the right levels of testing and code quality checks are in place.

Serve as a coach and mentor to platform architects, engineers, and platform product/process owners.

Essential Skills Needed:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related fields.

Minimum of 8 years of leadership experience on the ServiceNow Platform.

Understand platform architecture, data models, tables, relationships, scoped applications, integrations, security, upgrade implications, and platform limits.

The ability to break technical requirements into technical components, identify dependencies/complexity, estimate developer effort, and challenge estimates from the team partners.

JavaScript, Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, REST/SOAP APIs, ACLs, UI configurations, debugging and performance trouble shooting.

Understanding how major products/capabilities interact (not necessarily be the SME for every module).

Strong knowledge of Incident, Problem, Request, Change, Knowledge, Service Operations Workspace, CMDB and related workflows.

Understand CI relationships, Discovery, Service Mapping, CSDM, identification/reconciliation, and data quality.
